ImageDescription.value: The best view of the City of Asheville skyline is from Beaucatcher Mountain just east of town. The city and NCDOT have made accessing Beaucatcher challenging by planting thorny shrubs and installing 10’ fencing with barb wire. Invariably someone cuts open the fence providing access to the trail leading to the summit.
